analyst.summary: Jupiter Wagons benefited hugely from the recent Indian Railways wagon-ordering boom, but that cycle is now normalizing: the latest quarter showed revenue and profit down sharply year-on-year, margins compressing, and working capital (debtor and inventory days) stretching out. Despite this deceleration, the stock still trades at a rich ~62x trailing earnings and returns on capital have fallen to single digits. We see this as a cyclical capital-goods story past its peak, priced for growth it is not currently delivering, and recommend continuing to treat it as a Sell.
